records.title: CAGE: An Evaluation Framework for Cache-Augmented Generation Models
records.reason: The primary SBC proceedings DOI endpoint returned no accessible full text/PDF; search surfaced metadata/abstract only, so test configuration, metrics, and limitations could not be checked.

records.title: Enterprise LLM Router: Learning Quality–Capacity–Capability Trade-offs from 2026 Model Metadata
records.reason: The router predicts model quality/capacity from provider metadata and explicitly abstains where price/latency/deployment evidence is absent; it does not measure or improve model inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: AirMoE: Statistic-Augmented Over-the-Air MoE for Collaborative Intelligence
records.reason: The full text frames the method as wireless cloud–edge MoE with a cloud pretrained large-model backbone and distributed client experts, but its exemplar/evaluation is semantic segmentation and it optimizes wireless feature-routing/aggregation, not LLM inference or LLM serving.

records.title: Beyond Memory Leaderboards: Evaluating Scientific Memory as Budgeted Context Restoration
records.reason: This is an evaluation/benchmark contribution. Context budget is relevant to inference resource use, but the checked results do not quantify runtime or serving savings from the proposed protocol.
